_about: Which Fillout questions become client fields. Keyed by question id (names repeat and carry suffixes). niche is "all" or a label from niches. Adding a niche: add its label under niches and its questions under fields. Completeness: fields sharing a group count as one unit (filled if any is filled); optional fields and groups are left out of the expected count and shown as optional filled. An entry may give position {after, before} instead of id (the question directly between two known ids). expectedWhen {field, in} makes a field count only when another field holds one of those values; otherwise it is Not applicable. panel groups fields for the client record page (fillout/field-map.json "panels"); section stays the original form page. tier is needed, chase or optional (map.tiers); optional:true mirrors tier optional. manual:true marks a field with no Fillout question, set only on the record page.
